notes: Original Sieverts measurements (automated four-channel Sieverts apparatus, Experimental, Gas sorption analysis, main p. 3) on TR-GO, CR-GO, Fe-GS at 300 K and 77 K, 0.1-50 bar; BET areas from N2 at 77 K for the same samples. TR-GO and Fe-GS are majority carbon (reduced graphene oxide; arc-discharge graphene with Fe nanoclusters, flagged by metal_element at extraction). The paper reports that H2 and He volumes adsorbed by TR-GO at 77 K are nearly equal (Fig. 8b, 'no excess adsorption'); this concerns uptake basis for extraction, not eligibility. Table 1 values are quoted from other work, but Table 3 and Figs. 5-7 are the paper's own. No retraction flag (record is_retracted false; no retraction notice in text). Paper is primary research, not a review. No statement that all H2 uptake values were published before. SI (si1) has only Figs. S1-S3 (mass spectra, SEM, BET fits); no uptake data.
